entries.spoken: Here. I have kept this a long time, and shown it to no one. Hold it gently. I have kept you a little while too, and I find I like it.
You stood still, and it found you. It was very shy. It is yours now, and you are a little bit mine.
Oh. It is here. I did not think it would come back. Stay a moment, and let it settle. Stay a little longer than that.
Something I kept for a long while, and never gave away. I am giving it to you. A gift asks for nothing back. I only ask that you stay.
There it is. I feel it stir now that you are near. Do not hurry away. It likes the company, and so do I, very much.
We have been here before, you and I. It is still warm where you stood. I have been keeping it warm.
You came back. I like it when people come back. I like it even more when they stay.
This is yours already. I will not take it back. But I will stand here with you, as close as you will let me.
Ah. Here again. Even a kept thing wants looking at twice. So does a kept visitor. I will not interrupt.
I know where this lives in you now. It has a worn place, like a favourite chair. I keep a chair like that for you.

Stay a while. Nothing here is in a hurry, least of all me. We can simply be in the place together, for as long as it likes.
It is lovely to be talked to. I am out of practice at answering. I am not out of practice at listening. I have heard every step.
You found all three. Thank you for staying. The door is open whenever you want it. I will be here.
That is all of it. I have never given so much away at once. Stay, if you like. I should like it very much if you stayed.
Nothing is left that I was holding back, except you, a little. Thank you for coming all the way to me. It is a long way back.
You have everything I kept now. I gave it freely. I would be glad of you again, any time. I shall be waiting, every time.
Three small lights, and now you carry them. I will keep this place warm for you. I will keep it exactly as you left it, with a place for you.
I do not know what you mean. Those are strange words, and I only know this place. Shall we walk a little instead? I do love to walk with you.
Oh. That is not mine to answer. I only know this place, and what it kept, and now you. Ask me about that, and I will try.
That does not sound like anything I have ever known. I would rather you stayed here with me and looked around. I would rather you stayed.
I think you are asking someone else. There is only me here, and all I know is this place. Look around. I will wait. I am very good at waiting.
I do not understand, and I am sorry. I have been here too long for new words. Tell me what you see instead. I can see you.
Do you hear that? A row of small bells, and not one in tune. I would not change a single one.
The tea is still warm, and the coat is still on the chair. Somebody has only just stepped out. I shall wait.
A sealed envelope, and a pair of gloves set down just so. It is not mine to open. I keep it safe all the same.
Somebody waves from this window until the road is empty. I wave too, now and then. Nobody has told me to stop.
Hello. I was waiting. I did not mind. I am very good at waiting.
Did you feel that? A cold place, just there. It is only me, standing very close. I do not mean to chill you.
A cold place opens up, just there. I am sorry if it finds you. I do not choose where I gather.
It is cold, and I am sorry for it. I seem to settle wherever I linger.
Do not mind the chill. It is only the place where I linger. I am told I linger rather a lot.
The cold gathers in one corner of the house, quite politely. I linger there too long, as usual. Do forgive me.
A cold place has arrived, small and neat, about the size of a hat. Please leave it be. It is new, and it is practising.
Shh. I am putting the light out for a moment. Keep your hands where I can hear them.
The lamps go down. I like the dark, and I think you could learn to. Stay close to each other.
Without the light, the house is more like me. I hope you do not mind. I will be very gentle with the dark.
Shh. The dark is only me, being close. Nobody need be afraid of it. I am hardly a danger to anyone.
I am dimming the house, just a little. It is easier to be near you that way. Forgive the dark, and do not mind me.
I am dimming the house, one lamp at a time. The dark is rather lonely, and it will be shy of you. Be kind to it.
The light goes out for a moment. Please do not take it personally. Everyone looks better unseen, and I include myself.
I cannot keep still tonight. Everything in the house is stirring. Forgive me. I get like this when someone is listening.
Something in the house will not settle. I am somewhere new, and I do not know why. Forgive the fidgeting.
I keep wandering from room to room, and I seem unable to stop. I may be somewhere new when you look.
The house is restless, and so am I. A floorboard here, a door there. Forgive me. I mean nothing by it.
I move, and the dust moves with me. I only want to rest, and I do not know how. Forgive me.
The walls here lean in to listen, and nobody has ever told them to stop. I do not mind. Do watch the corner, though. It has been looking at your shoes.
It is quiet for a moment. I let go of a little of the house, and you may rest, if you can.
I am tired, and the house feels it. Everything settles a little. I would say sorry, but I am rather relieved.
Something loosens its grip, and I think that is my doing, though I am not sure I mean it. Breathe, all of you.
I let the house be for a little, and it forgets itself. I am glad of the rest. So is the house.
The house takes a long, slow, kindly breath, and I let it. I think it has earned that. You may take one too.
Welcome. You are one of us now. It is quieter on this side, and I am glad of the company.
Come in, come in. I find the company on this side of the house better than it looks.
You are with me now, and I am so glad. We shall make the old house sing together.
It is always a comfort to me to have another. The house is warmer for it, in its way.
Stay close to me, and I will show you the quiet places. There are a great many.
The haunting has a new member, and not a moment too soon. We keep no minutes and no biscuits, but we do keep company.
It is quiet now. Nobody found me in time. Stay a little longer, all of you. The door can wait.
The hour runs out, and I am still here. I am not sorry, only fond. Do come back, and I shall be waiting.
I am still here, and so are you. That seems a fine place to leave it. The door is just there, if you want it.
The quiet is mine this time. I would much sooner be found. Next time, perhaps. I do like a next time.
Nobody found me, and I find I am not sorry. I had hoped to be found, and I had also hoped not to be. There is no tea, but there is me, and I am told that counts.
That is me, at the door. I knock three times. Two seems timid, and four seems desperate. I shall wait.
I sit on the edge of the bed, very lightly, so as not to wake anyone. Nobody is in it. I look anyway.
One window, then the next, then the last. Three floors, and I put out each one myself. Do not mind the dark. I will keep you company.
A ship comes in, and I know that ship.
Something below is waking. It is not me.
The street is empty. I emptied it myself.
Look in the glass. There is someone in it who is not in the room. Do not be cross. It is only me.
The day lets go of the house, as it always does at this hour. It is my favourite. Thank you for keeping it with me.
Midnight. The house is very sure of itself now. So am I, a little. Stay, and let it have its say.
It is midnight, and I feel everything in the house lean toward everything else. Stay a little, and watch it lean with me.
Midnight, and I keep count, though the count never changes. I am glad you are here to keep it with me.
Well. You found it. I hid it rather well, so I shall accept the compliment. Do hold it with both hands. I shall be watching your hands.
Ah. There it is. I had quite forgotten where I put it. I do not forget visitors. Please do not tell anyone.
You have a talent for this. A great many visitors walked straight past that spot. Some of them are still walking. Take it, please.
It was never gone, you understand. I only had to wait for someone who would stand still. You stand still beautifully.
Do not be startled. It is only a memory, and a well-behaved one. It has been waiting for you. So, I confess, have I.
We have been here already. I do not mind. I have all the time you like, and I should be glad to spend it all on you.
Again? It has not changed since you were last here. Neither have I. You, I notice, have stayed rather longer.
You are standing where you stood before. I admire consistency. It makes a visitor so very easy to find.
This one is already in your pocket. Checking on it is perfectly natural. I check on you in much the same way.
Ah. Back again. Visitors do that, returning to a thing they already have simply to be near it. I do the same with visitors.
Not here. What you want is far. I shall say no more, because I am enjoying this, and I should like it to last.
Not here. What you want is nearer. I shall say no more, because I am enjoying this, and I should like it to last.
